name: @loom/planner-decide-scope
description: A planner that decides THROUGH loom's decide scope: a support-ticket triage flow calls a loom-ui ReferencePlanner with the real ctx, whose model reaches the LLM effect via scopeInvoker, so the call is authorized and observed as the deciding execution (workflowId, executionId, delegated principal), a flow without the grant is denied, and a replay serves the plan from the log without calling the model.
